name: Kamino Liquidity (yvaults)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Upgrades are a 5-of-7 multisig with a 24-hour delay, but the strategy admin is a different 5-of-7 multisig with no delay at all, so the undelayed path sets the timelock score.
narrative.tag: same signer shape, zero delay on the admin path
narrative.detail: The program upgrade multisig and the GlobalConfig.adminAuthority multisig are distinct Squads v4 accounts with the same 5-of-7 shape. Only the delay differs (24 hours versus none), so only the timelock sub-score dropped. The admin address was decoded at a byte offset computed from Kamino's published codec and cross-checked against the live account bytes. Not decoded: actionsAuthority (name suggests an operational role), pendingAdmin, and the restrict-only emergencyCouncil and unfreezeAuthority. Scouting found all 7 upgrade members also sit on the Kamino Lend upgrade multisig. DefiLlama listed over $50M TVL (2026-09-17).

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: account owned by program 6LtLpnUF… -> program -> ProgramData 8n11WG… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig E7994UpSGhSpbpnuSepPXHBuMy3eRvHJL36DjTs1kb2b
independent_read.disagree: the timelock score says no delay (0), the Squads multisig enforces a native time lock of 24 h
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 5-of-7 of 7 plain keys; delay: 24 h Squads time lock
